segments.text: Hi, what's up? It's Stephanie Poetry. I just want to come on here and talk a little bit
about how meaningful 2025 was for me. I put so much music out and did a lot of collaborations
and I just want to thank every single one of you who has kept supporting me and listened
to my music. And yeah, I'm like really grateful at the fact that I could be, you know, on
one side of the earth and you guys are on the other side and yet we're all able
to still stay connected. And I hope that in 2026 we can continue doing so and stay being
creative and most importantly, stay being kind. I hope that this year has been amazing for
you and I hope that next year would be even better.
